Nigerian authorities have dismantled an industrial-scale methamphetamine laboratory in the southeastern state of Enugu, seizing more than 1.5 tonnes of the drug and arresting five Mexican nationals and a Nigerian businessman, according to the BBC. The country's National Drug Law Enforcement Agency values the seizure at $227 million. It is the fourth industrial-scale meth lab with alleged ties to Mexican cartels discovered in Nigeria in recent months.
